name: Electioneering
overview: The narrative of electioneering in 2 Samuel 15 reveals how Absalom strategically sought to win the hearts of Israel by positioning himself as a more accessible and just judge than King David. By setting up a public presence and personally greeting those who came to the king for judgment, Absalom effectively undermined royal authority and gained popular support. His actions demonstrate a calculated attempt to usurp leadership through manipulation and false promises of justice.
